notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wingmantle Chaplain, adding {1}.
Wingmantle Chaplain dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Wingmantle Chaplain from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Wingmantle Chaplain enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Bird creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Birds, adding {3}.
Repeat.
